description: This file defines an adapter class for integrating Anthropic's LLM API with the Pipecat framework. It handles conversion of message formats, manages system and user messages, supports message logging with sanitization, and converts tool schemas for Anthropic's function-calling API.

classes.name: AnthropicLLMInvocationParams
classes.description: TypedDict defining parameters for invoking Anthropic's LLM API, including system message, messages list, and tools.

classes.name: AnthropicLLMAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for converting Pipecat's message and tool schemas to Anthropic's function calling format, managing message formatting, system message extraction, and logging sanitization.

classes.name: ConvertedMessages
classes.description: Dataclass container for holding converted Anthropic-formatted messages and optional system message.

methods.name: str id_for_llm_specific_messages(self)
methods.description: Returns the identifier string 'anthropic' for messages specific to Anthropic models.

methods.name: AnthropicLLMInvocationParams get_llm_invocation_params( self, context: LLMContext, enable_prompt_caching: bool )
methods.description: Generates the Anthropic-specific invocation parameters from a universal LLM context, with optional prompt caching.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_messages_for_logging(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Prepares and sanitizes messages from the context for safe logging, removing sensitive data and images.

methods.name: ConvertedMessages _from_universal_context_messages( self, universal_context_messages: List[LLMContextMessage] )
methods.description: Converts a list of universal LLM context messages into Anthropic's format, handling system message extraction and message merging.

methods.name: MessageParam _from_universal_context_message(self, message: LLMContextMessage)
methods.description: Converts individual context message to Anthropic format, delegating to specific conversion methods based on message type.

methods.name: MessageParam _from_anthropic_specific_message(self, message: LLMSpecificMessage)
methods.description: Converts Anthropic-specific messages, such as 'thought' messages, into standard Anthropic message format.

methods.name: MessageParam _from_standard_message(self, message: LLMStandardMessage)
methods.description: Converts a universal standard message into Anthropic format, handling tool messages, tool calls, and content formatting, including image URL handling.

methods.name: List[MessageParam] _with_cache_control_markers(self, messages: List[MessageParam])
methods.description: Adds cache control markers to messages for prompt caching, targeting the last two user messages.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _to_anthropic_function_format(function: FunctionSchema)
methods.description: Converts a schema function into Anthropic's function format for API calls.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema)
methods.description: Converts a ToolsSchema into a list of function definitions formatted for Anthropic.

ctags.name: get_messages_for_logging
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_messages_for_logging(self, context: LLMContext) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: to_provider_tools_format
ctags.pattern: /^    def to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
